$comment: Which Figma variable mode is which theme.

Figma's image endpoint renders a node as it currently stands in the file and takes no mode parameter, so a dark golden means the node must actually be in dark mode when it is shot. That is a property of the file, not of a command-line flag — so the shooter READS the mode back over REST and refuses to write a sheet whose name does not match what it rendered. Without that, one forgotten mode switch produces a light sheet called sheet.dark.png and every dark comparison is quietly wrong.
Set the mode with the toolkit plugin, or: setExplicitVariableModeForCollection(collection, mode) on the component set.
